big_poes.evidence: 2026-11-20 in-game snapshot diff (11 labeled snapshots, the maintainer's Rekarina run: one snapshot per Poe kill, final one after all 10 were sold). 0x40772671 is a 10-entry sold-flags array: entry i flips true in the snapshot taken after the Poe at location i is sold (sales came in batches of 4, 2 and 4; all true after the 10th sale). 0xec52c09a is the complementary still-alive array: entry i flips false at the kill, one entry per snapshot in kill order. GhostShop_CouponNum exists in this build and is 100 points per sold Poe (0 -> 1000), so its raw value is points, not a Poe count. The named keys HyruleField_Defeat_BigPoe_01-09 exist but stayed false through the whole session (_010 is absent); in this build the per-location state lives in the two arrays.
